subject: physics

hotspots.label: Hanging Object
hotspots.description: The object whose weight you are measuring — its mass never changes, only the pull on it does.
hotspots.positionHint: A backpack hanging from the scale hook.
hotspots.function: Carries the mass whose gravitational pull the scale reads.

hotspots.label: Spring Scale
hotspots.description: The scale stretches exactly in proportion to the force pulling the hook — a direct weight reading.
hotspots.positionHint: A stand with a coiled spring and hook, mounted near the center.
hotspots.function: Measures the gravitational force as spring stretch.

hotspots.label: Newton Marks
hotspots.description: The plate of newton marks the needle points to — the weight readout in N.
hotspots.positionHint: Tick marks printed on a plate beside the spring.

hotspots.label: Weight Readout
hotspots.description: The live weight in newtons, equal to mass × g for the current location.
hotspots.positionHint: A floating badge showing N values that change with the dial.
hotspots.function: Displays weight = mass × g for the selected world.

hotspots.label: Location Dial
hotspots.description: Earth, Moon, and space icons — turning it changes g and the weight while the kg tag stays fixed.
hotspots.positionHint: A dial with three worlds on the front post.
hotspots.function: Changes gravitational field strength to show weight varying.

hotspots.label: Mass Tag
hotspots.description: A small tag on the object showing its constant mass in kg — the number gravity can't change.
hotspots.positionHint: A label sticker attached to the backpack.
hotspots.function: Reminds that mass is constant while weight varies.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background with soft vignette, no floor grid. A slim metal spring scale stand, a canvas backpack, and a dial with three world icons. Saturated color only on readout dot, dial, and tag. Neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 (visualized metal look approximated with roughness ~0.35 and light value contrast). Stand: warm steel grey. Spring: chrome-like but matte. Backpack: canvas amber. Dial: paper with Earth/Moon/stars badge icons. Readout text runtime overlay.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: weight as the gravitational force on a mass, read by a spring scale and varied by location.

GEOMETRY: scale stand at center (0,1.25,0 top), a coiled spring, hook, and a hanging backpack (approx 0.5×0.7×0.25) centered at (0,0.35,0). Newton plate on the left of the stand, weight badge to the right, mass tag sticker on the pack, and a location dial on a front-left post.

INTERACTION: the app stretches the spring; needle/s opening on the plate tracks the value W = m·g; the dial cycles Earth 9.8, Moon 1.6, Space 0 with a gentle spring animation and the display updating; the kg tag never changes.

LAYERS: scale+pack; marks; weight badge; dial+tag.

NAMED NODES: ScaleStand, SpringCoil, Hook, Backpack, NewtonPlate, Needle, WeightBadge, MassTag, LocationDial, BasePad. 6-10k tris.
